features.quote: Sandbox per episode, subprocess test execution with a hard timeout and output truncation
features.justification_quote: the timeout and truncation bound cost and latency
Long enough to enter a spiral, short enough to stay cheap

features.justification_quote: Abandonment is a key outcome, so we make it an explicit, detectable action
